description: Synthetic micro-frontend host: dynamic MFE loader via template-literal import(). Models the failure mode where modules loaded at runtime appear as isolated clusters.

falsePositives.note: users/* is loaded via dynamicMfeLoader('users') -> import(`../mfes/${name}/index`). Static analysis misses the template-literal import.
products/* is loaded via dynamicMfeLoader('products') -> same template-literal pattern.
mfeDisplayName is integration code that gets registered at runtime; should not be flagged as dead util.
